description: An unconference's public declaration (one per gathering DID, rkey "self"). Modelled line-for-line on freeschool.draft.school, plus the things a gathering has that a school does not: dates, a lifecycle phase, and a strongRef to its own community.lexicon.calendar.event. Written by the gathering actor. Names no person: peers are other gatherings' DIDs.

event.description: The gathering's own community.lexicon.calendar.event (the thing a generic calendar client reads), in this same repo.

peers.description: DIDs of peer gatherings or schools this gathering federates with (their PDS hosts are followed directly). Organisations, never people.

tags.description: Tags this gathering routes on for coop.lexicon.event.listing exchange.
